saved: Toast after a labeling card's settings were saved.
save-failed: Error when a labeling setting could not be saved.
load-failed: Error when a labeling card's settings could not be read.
unsure: A label's name in the evaluation table: the model said it wasn't sure.
card.threshold: Label of a number field: how sure (in percent) the model must be.
card.per-day: Label of a number field: the most calls to the model a day.
card.limits: {{min}} and {{max}} are percentages (numbers only). {{defaults}} is card.defaults' text: the server's threshold and daily calls.
card.defaults: The server's defaults: a percentage and a number of calls a day. The base form ("…") shows while they load.
card.status: Accessible name of the card's part on the model and its evaluation.
card.model: Term in a list: the model that labels; its value is the model's name.
card.no-model: When the workspace has no default shared model to label with.
card.its-labels: Term in a list: whether the model's labels count yet.
card.golden: Term in a list: the "golden set", the labels admins set by hand that the model is evaluated against.
card.golden-count: How many labels admins set by hand.
card.golden-needs: {{golden}} is card.golden-count's text; {{min}} is how many an evaluation needs.
card.calls: Calls to the model in the last 24 hours: {{calls}} of the daily cap {{perDay}}, {{evaluating}} of them for evaluations, {{tokens}} tokens (units the model counts text in), {{cost}} an amount in US dollars or card.cost-unknown.
card.cost-unknown: In card.calls when the provider didn't report a cost; lowercase.
card.no-cost: {{text}} is card.calls' text; the count is calls whose cost wasn't reported.
card.evaluate: Button: asks the model about every golden label and scores its answers.
eval.failed: The evaluation's result when it failed; {{error}} is the error text (not translated) or eval.unknown.
eval.unknown: In eval.failed when there is no error text; lowercase.
eval.few-answered: The evaluation's result: the model was sure of {{answered}} labels, under the {{min}} needed.
eval.imprecise: The evaluation's result: {{precision}} and {{threshold}} are percentages ("82%").
eval.summary: The last evaluation in a sentence: <strong> marks its start. {{when}} is a date and time, {{version}} the model's name (not translated), {{verdict}} one of eval.running, eval.failed, eval.passed, eval.few-answered or eval.imprecise. {{golden}} labels asked about, {{answered}} the model was sure of; {{precision}} and {{accuracy}} are percentages.
eval.per-label: Accessible name of the table of results per label.
eval.admin-labels: Column heading: how many golden labels have this value.
eval.model-said: Column heading: how many times the model gave this label.
eval.precision: Column heading: the share of the model's labels of this value that were right.
eval.recall: Column heading: the share of the golden labels of this value the model found.
failures.intro: "Reliability" is a page of Operations. {{unclassified}} is failures.categories.unclassified, the category of failures no rule sorted.
failures.switch: Switch title. "Unclassified" is failures.categories.unclassified; keep the same word.
failures.categories.stopped: Each failures.categories.*: a category of failed turns, as Reliability shows it; here, the label names in the evaluation table.
intent.title: Card title. "Intent": what a person wanted from a session (asking, writing, analyzing…).
intent.intro: "Socios": AI agents. "Value" and "Themes" are pages of Operations.
intent.list.description: {{min}} and {{max}}: how many intents the list may have. "Golden set": the labels admins set by hand that the model is evaluated against.
intent.list.value: Label of a field: an intent's value, a short lowercase word the model answers with.
intent.list.meaning: Label of a field: what the intent means, as the model is told.
intent.list.duplicate: Error under an intent's fields when two have the same value.
intent.list.no-meaning: Error under an intent's fields when its meaning is empty.
intent.list.remove: Button: removes one intent from the list.
intent.list.remove-label: Accessible name of the Remove button: {{value}} is the intent's value; the unnamed form when it has none yet.
intent.list.saved: Toast after the list of intents was saved.
intent.list.reset: Button: goes back to the default list of intents.
themes.intro: "Operations → Themes" is a page of the dashboard. {{min}}: the fewest different people before a theme is named.
themes.outcomes.resolved: Each themes.outcomes.*: whether a session's person seems to have got what they came for; the label names in the evaluation table.
learning.title: Card title. "Learning": Socio's feature that turns repeated work into skills for socios. "Triage": sorting which conversations it analyzes.
learning.intro: {{chars}} is a number of characters. "Session intent" is the card of that name above; keep the same words. "private" is a label the model gives.
learning.labels.repeatable: Each learning.labels.*: a label the model gives a conversation; the label names in the evaluation table.
